name: 45074-longprefill-16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine, no expert parallelism, no NCCL, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: MoE decoder, DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, bf16: 27 layers (layer 0 dense, 26 MoE), 64 routed + 2 shared experts, top-6 routing, hidden 2048, 15.7B total / ~2.4B activated, ~31 GB of weights. Attention is dense multi-head latent attention -- 16 heads, kv_lora_rank 512, q_lora_rank null, head_size 576, v_head_dim 128.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup 50%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 64 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. Seed static 45074.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix reuse: 32768 prompt tokens in and 1 token out, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0.0, ignore_eos. The chat template and add_special_tokens put a few tokens more than 32768 on the wire, which is what the report counts.
purpose: A document analysis service where 16 concurrent users submit 32,000-token reports to a 16-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Flat reader: a line starting with a space is skipped, so every key
# must be top-level and every value must fit on one line.
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# Required, not decorative: `deepseek_v2` is a remote-code model_type, so AutoConfig cannot load
# this repo's config without it.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 40960
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 64
enable-prefix-caching: false
enforce-eager: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
